activity.notes: Toypurina, a Gabrieleno/Tongva woman, participated as an Indigenous leader in the 1785 revolt against Mission San Gabriel. ATLAS links this Activity to the Spanish Empire with relation opposes rather than inventing a unified Tongva state from an ethnolinguistic label.

sources.title: Mission San Gabriel Archangel — U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service states that Indigenous leaders, including the Gabrieleno woman Toypurina, attempted a rebellion at Mission San Gabriel in 1785.
